ticket.subject: Which attribute for email in SAML
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

I look after our account at Larkspur Labs. We are setting up SAML single sign-on with our identity provider. Which attribute should carry the user's email address?

Nothing is broken; we just want to get the setup right the first time. We want to switch everyone over before the end of the month.

A reply in the next few days would be great. A setup guide would help.

Kind regards,
Dana Moreau
